summary.text: Mikel Wein, an independent who lives in Letcher County, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kentucky's 5th Congressional District to Hal Rogers.
He said he spent recent months knocking on doors across the district.

paragraphs.text: Wein says he lives in a log cabin in Letcher County on land that has been in his family for over a century.
He says his first job was as a contract archaeologist, working at Fort Lee for about a year.
In the months before the election, Wein says, he knocked on doors and listened to residents across the 5th District. He was on the 2026 general election ballot as an independent.
He campaigned on ending corporate control of Eastern Kentucky's land and energy resources, a national healthcare system, and reducing U.S. military spending abroad.
He received 2.1% of the vote to Hal Rogers's 71.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
